chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: The water of Zamzam is a remedy for whatever it is drunk for.

key_terms.دَوَاءٌ: Remedy, medicine, cure — used here to affirm the healing properties of Zamzam water
key_terms.مَاءُ زَمْزَمَ: Zamzam water — the sacred spring within the Masjid al-Haram, believed to have gushed miraculously for Hajar (Hagar)
key_terms.مِمَّا شُرِبَ لَهُ: For whatever it is drunk for — indicating that the cure corresponds to the specific intention of the person drinking

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about the healing properties of Zamzam water?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrates through a chain reaching back to Imam Ali (AS) and ultimately to the Prophet (SAWW) this statement about the curative properties of Zamzam water. The Prophet declared that Zamzam water is a medicine and remedy for any ailment for which a person drinks it with intention. This teaching reflects the Islamic tradition of viewing the sacred Zamzam well — located within the Masjid al-Haram in Mecca — as a source of both spiritual and physical healing.
